messages.subject: Interpretation of predictor within-person level
parts:
Hi everyone!
I have fitted a random intercept cross-lagged panel model (RI-CLPM) in R (lavaan). 
I want to see how trauma affects the cross-lagged predictions. I'm not sure how to interpret the findings. Anyone know (see results in bold/italic)?

This is my code: 
# residual regressions
# ---------------------------
# sk
#ssk2 ~ p2*ssk1 + p4*ede1
